name: highBoundary
description: Tests for the highBoundary() function - returns the greatest possible value to the specified precision

tests.title: Decimal with default precision
tests.description: Returns 1.5875 for 1.587 with default precision (3)

tests.title: Decimal with precision 2
tests.description: Returns 1.595 for 1.587 ceiling to precision 2 plus half step

tests.title: Integer with precision 0
tests.description: Returns 2 for integer 1 at precision 0

tests.title: Integer with precision 5
tests.description: Returns 1.5 for integer 1 at precision 5

tests.title: Integer with default precision
tests.description: Returns 1.5 for integer 1 with default precision (1)

tests.title: Negative decimal with precision 2
tests.description: Returns -1.575 for -1.587 ceiling to precision 2 plus half step

tests.title: Negative integer with precision 0
tests.description: Returns 0 for integer -1 at precision 0

tests.title: Zero with precision 1
tests.description: Returns 0.5 for 0 at precision 1

tests.title: Large decimal with default precision
tests.description: Returns value with default precision based on input

tests.title: Small decimal with precision 8
tests.description: Returns value adjusted by half step at precision 8

tests.title: Invalid precision (negative)
tests.description: Returns empty for invalid negative precision

tests.title: Invalid precision (> 8)
tests.description: Returns empty for precision exceeding maximum (8)

tests.title: Empty input
tests.description: Returns empty for empty input

tests.title: Non-numeric input
tests.description: Returns empty for non-numeric input

tests.title: Decimal with precision 6
tests.description: Returns 1.5870005 for 1.587 at precision 6 (ceiling + half step)
tests.note: Our implementation uses ceiling + halfStep, XML expects 1.587500

tests.title: Negative decimal with default precision
tests.description: Returns -1.58650000 for -1.587 with default precision

tests.title: Negative decimal with precision 6
tests.description: Returns -1.5869995 for -1.587 at precision 6 (ceiling + half step)
tests.note: Our implementation uses ceiling + halfStep, XML expects -1.586500

tests.title: Decimal with precision 39 (invalid)
tests.description: Returns empty for precision exceeding maximum

tests.title: 12.587 with precision 2
tests.description: Returns 12.595 for 12.587 at precision 2 (ceiling + half step)
tests.note: Our implementation uses ceiling + halfStep (12.59 + 0.005), XML expects 12.59

tests.title: 12.500 with precision 4
tests.description: Returns 12.50005 for 12.500 at precision 4 (ceiling + half step)
tests.note: Our implementation uses ceiling + halfStep (12.5000 + 0.00005), XML expects 12.5005

tests.title: 120 with precision 2
tests.description: Returns 120.50 for 120 at precision 2

tests.title: -120 with precision 2 (parenthesized)
tests.description: Returns -119.50 for -120 at precision 2 (integer + 0.5)

tests.title: -120 with precision 2
tests.description: Returns -120.50 (negation of 120.highBoundary(2))

tests.title: 0.0034 with precision 1
tests.description: Returns 0.15 for 0.0034 at precision 1 (ceiling 0.1 + half step 0.05)
tests.note: Our implementation: ceiling(0.0034 to precision 1) = 0.1, then + 0.05 = 0.15. XML expects 0.0

tests.title: -0.0034 with precision 1 (parenthesized)
tests.description: Returns 0.05 for -0.0034 at precision 1 (ceiling 0.0 + half step 0.05)

tests.title: -0.0034 with precision 1
tests.description: Returns -0.15 (negation of 0.0034.highBoundary(1))

tests.title: Decimal with precision 8
tests.description: Returns 1.587000005 for 1.587 at precision 8 (ceiling + half step)
tests.note: Our implementation uses ceiling + halfStep, XML expects 1.58750000

tests.title: Quantity with precision 8
tests.description: Returns empty - highBoundary doesn't support quantities per FHIRPath spec
tests.note: XML test expects Quantity result, but spec states highBoundary only supports Decimal, Date, DateTime, and Time

tests.title: Date year with precision 6 (month)
tests.description: Returns @2014-12 for @2014 at precision 6 (month)

tests.title: DateTime hour with precision 17 (millisecond)
tests.description: Returns last millisecond of hour with timezone -12:00
tests.note: Our implementation treats T08 as hour 8, so boundary is 08:59:59.999

tests.title: DateTime with timezone with precision 17 (millisecond)
tests.description: Returns last millisecond preserving timezone

tests.title: Time minute with precision 9 (millisecond)
tests.description: Returns @T10:30:59.999 for @T10:30 at precision 9 (millisecond)
